findings.class: a claim in a report that no command output supports
findings.cause: U3's report states 'tools/run_serial_compat.py is not split. 519 -> 514 physical lines'. The file grew instead: the deleted derived comparisons were outweighed by _require_discovery's new docstring and widened drift message.
findings.evidence: git show 7ecf064b:tools/run_serial_compat.py | wc -l -> 519; wc -l tools/run_serial_compat.py at the tip -> 523; git diff c43e93ab HEAD -- tools/run_serial_compat.py is empty, so 523 is U3's own candidate. tools/validate.py exits 0 and emits no line-count warning, so nothing machine-enforced moved.
findings.impact: The spec's section 6 defers 'tools/run_serial_compat.py's 519 lines' and decision 7 says 'D3's deletions reduce it'. Both are now wrong by 9 lines in the wrong direction. A successor sizing that split would start from a number no command produces.
findings.smallest_change: No code change. Correct the number where the run carries it forward -- the frame journal's deferred-item line and any successor note -- to 519 -> 523.

findings.class: a branch that no check can reach
findings.cause: The widening's `if state == "retired": return True` short-circuits every case that used to reach the trailing all(record.kind == 'lifecycle'). A lone attempt can only be live (refused by the first line) or retired (returned by the second): the only other state, 'replaced', is written at scripts/tickets_attempts.py:483 in the same mutation that appends the replacement, so a replaced attempt is never lone and len(attempts) != 1 refuses first.
findings.evidence: ATTEMPT_STATES is ['live','replaced','retired']. Mutant M6 (trailing expression -> return False) leaves 119 tests green across every module that reaches the predicate, with an identical control run; grep shows scripts/tickets_lifecycle.py:222 is the predicate's only production caller and tests/test_dispatch_v1.py and tests/test_staleness_and_remedies.py its only test readers. test_an_attempt_that_never_launched_hands_its_status_back (test_dispatch_v1.py:743), which U2 names as grading 'the other arm of the or', retires the attempt at :753 and so takes the retired branch too.
findings.impact: Behaviour is correct; the cost is that the predicate now carries a limb a reader cannot exercise, and the 'never launched' arm of the stated law has no independent check.
findings.smallest_change: None inside this run. Collapsing the predicate to `len(attempts) == 1 and attempts[0].get('state') != 'live'` would differ from the shape section 2 fixes, and section 0 says a unit reports against a closed decision rather than reversing it. Carry to the planner as a successor: either narrow section 2's shape, or add one comment line beside the branch naming the shape it holds.

observations.subject: U3's narrowing of plan_regeneration's guard
observations.ruling: sound. The guard now renders the regenerated manifest with the committed roster restored and requires the committed roster bytes back, so it still catches a roster whose committed spelling is not what regeneration writes -- test_a_roster_regeneration_would_respell_aborts_the_write proves that with a whitespace perturbation, and U3 recorded its can-fail reading. 'A row added or altered' is unreachable by construction because prune_sentinels is a pure filter over the committed rows; U3 says so. load_manifest's REQUIRED_CATEGORIES subset check at tools/run_serial_compat.py:72 is untouched, so a prune that empties a category is still loudly red.
